description: MCM (Mod Configuration Menu) compatibility test. P0 gate mod — 500+ configurable mods depend on it.
assertions: assert((function() for _,u in ipairs(Ext.Mod.GetLoadOrder()) do local m=Ext.Mod.GetMod(u); local n=string.gsub(string.lower((m and m.Info and m.Info.Name) or ''), '[%s_%-]', ''); if string.find(n, 'configurationmenu', 1, true) then return true end end return false end)(), 'Mod Configuration Menu present in load order')

assert((function() local size=Ext.IMGUI.GetViewportSize(); return type(size) == 'table' and type(size[1]) == 'number' and size[1] > 0 and type(size[2]) == 'number' and size[2] > 0 end)(), 'IMGUI viewport query executes')

assert((function() local event=Ext.ModEvents['BG3SECompat']['MCM']; local fired=false; local id=event:Subscribe(function() fired=true end); event:Throw({}); event:Unsubscribe(id); return fired end)(), 'ModEvents roundtrip executes')
assert(pcall(Ext.RegisterNetListener, '_bg3se_compat_mcm_probe', function() end), 'network listener registration executes')
assert((function() local id=Ext.Events.Tick:Subscribe(function() end); local ok=type(id) == 'number'; Ext.Events.Tick:Unsubscribe(id); return ok end)(), 'Tick event subscribe roundtrip executes')
notes: MCM is pure Lua (18K lines). IMGUI on Metal is the highest-risk subsystem. Keyboard input (INSERT default hotkey) requires CGEventTap forwarding.
